titleBack: This Place Can Be A Little Rough

flipToBack.timing: RequiredGameTextTriggerAction (singleton) on TriggerConditions.isTableChanged; auto-fires whenever condition holds
flipToBack.prose: Flip if you have completed two Kessel Runs OR you occupy two battlegrounds with smugglers (occupy-with: your smuggler at each of 2 battlegrounds).

children.req: occupies-with >=2 locations (your presence at location, with your actor-filter card there)

flipToFront.timing: RequiredGameTextTriggerAction (singleton) on TriggerConditions.isTableChanged; auto-fires whenever condition holds
flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if you have NOT completed two Kessel Runs AND you do NOT occupy two battlegrounds. NOTE: back-hold occupy check is PLAIN occupy (smugglers NOT required), weaker than the front flip requirement.

children.req: occupies >=2 locations (plain presence, no actor requirement)

requirementSemantics: Front flip alternative A = COUNTER: two completed Kessel Run Utinni Effects (persistent game-state counter; once earned it holds both flip and back-hold forever).
Front flip alternative B = OCCUPY-WITH: your presence at 2 battlegrounds (any type, site or system) with a smuggler of yours at each.
Back hold = plain OCCUPY 2 battlegrounds (no smuggler needed) OR the 2-Kessel-Run counter; only if BOTH fail does it flip back.
typedIdentities: Filters.Kessel_Run - Utinni Effect counted by hasCompletedUtinniEffect
Filters.battleground - flip gate locations (any battleground, not just sites)

Filters.hasAbilityOrHasPermanentPilotWithAbility / Filters.or(Filters.Luke, Filters.smuggler, Filters.freighter, Filters.and(Icon.INDEPENDENT, Filters.starship)) - front deploy +6 tax and its exemptions
Filters.Kessel_system - opponent game text canceled there
setupAndPullRoutes: Setup (front, required): deploy Cantina from Reserve Deck; EXCEPT if a Cantina is on table that cannot be converted by deployment, instead place your Cantina from Reserve Deck out of play. Card10_026.java:53-66
Setup (front, required): deploy Docking Bay 94 from Reserve Deck. Card10_026.java:67-73
Setup (front, required): deploy Tatooine system from Reserve Deck. Card10_026.java:74-80

Front, once during each of your deploy phases (GameTextActionId.WATCH_YOUR_STEP__UPLOAD_CORELLIA_OR_KESSEL): take Corellia or Kessel system into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Card10_026.java:106-124

Back, once per turn: play one Interrupt from Lost Pile as if from hand, then place it out of play (top-level + as-response before/after variants, all sharing GameTextActionId.THIS_PLACE_CAN_BE_A_LITTLE_ROUGH__PLAY_INTERRUPT_FROM_LOST_PILE). Card10_026_BACK.java:66-126
otherObligations: Front (until end of game, added after deployment completes): opponent activates no Force at your Cantina. Card10_026.java:89-91
Front (until end of game): your cards with ability are deploy +6 except Luke, smugglers, freighters, and [Independent] starships (plus dejarik-rules variant). Card10_026.java:92-98
Front (until end of game): opponent's game text on Kessel (system) is canceled. Card10_026.java:99-101
Back: your Force generation +1 at each system you control with a smuggler. Card10_026_BACK.java:57
Back: opponent's Force generation at non-battleground locations limited to 1. Card10_026_BACK.java:58
Back: add one battle destiny when 2+ of your smugglers in battle. Card10_026_BACK.java:59
Back: Sense, Alter, and Keep Your Eyes Open may not be played (no player restriction - blocks both players). Card10_026_BACK.java:61
